planSource: docs/GROWTH_PLAN_30DAY.md (v3, 2026-08-25) — conflict dikhe to GROWTH_PLAN.md jeetta hai

owner.text: Crash dashboard 5 min (production chal raha hai)

teammate.text: 15 min: reviews reply (24h rule) + DMs + dono ka WhatsApp status

both.text: Sheet update — jo hua so likha; scoreboard khaali = kaam hua hi nahi

days.label: Din 0 — Pehle se taiyaar rakho
both: Play Console access dono ke paas (teammate ko read access kaafi)
RevenueCat dashboard access confirm — Monday scoreboard ka 'naye paid' row yahin se aayega
PLAY_LISTING.md ka final text dono ek baar padho — listing me ab auto-odometer hero hai
Production baseline note karo: aaj ka crash-free %, auto-odo/refuel/paywall ka koi complaint pattern reviews me?
Google Sheet import: Odo_30Day_Launch_Tracker.xlsx (content calendar + scoreboard + groups + seed + spend + gate)

days.label: Din 1
days.weekGoal: HAFTA 1 (Din 1–7): review prompt + referral M1 me hi build, teammate ka content system khada (channels + freelancer + groups). Auto-odo/refuel/paywall ko chhedna nahi — production code hai.
owner: Pro-gate audit (2–3h) — verify karo, build nahi: gates sirf output pe (PDF export, OCR, unlimited docs, trends/multi-car), input pe KABHI nahi (reminders, auto-odo, refuel — flywheel free rehta hai)
teammate: Instagram business account: @odo.app (na mile to closest variant). Bio: ek line + Play link
YouTube channel (Shorts ke liye) — same naam, same bio
Canva free account + owner se app ke 2 brand colours / font le lo

days.label: Din 2
owner: Review-prompt design + build shuru (2–3h) — happy-moment trigger (PDF export ke baad / achhi mileage reveal pe), app-open pe KABHI nahi
teammate: Freelancer hunt (F2): Fiverr ('instagram reels editor hindi'), Upwork, Internshala, Telegram editing groups, Srinagar/Jammu creator FB groups — shortlist 5, MARKETING_ROADMAP.md §F2 ka brief sabko bhejo

days.label: Din 3
owner: Review-prompt build continue (2–3h)
teammate: 30 groups ki master list (sheet ke Groups tab me): Kashmir used-car FB groups, J&K owner groups, r/CarsIndia, Team-BHP, WhatsApp groups
Freelancer jawabo me se 2 best chuno → dono ko 1-1 paid trial reel (₹300–400); raw material Din 4 ko jayega

days.label: Din 4
owner: Review-prompt build complete + internal QA (2–3h)
teammate: Recording session #1 (REEL_SCRIPTS_1-3.md ke steps se): pehle seed data bharo (Swift/WagonR, 6–8 service entries, PUC expiry ~20 din, odometer 48,236 type), phir Reel 1 (#1 PUC) + Reel 2 (#12 mileage) ke clips
Bonus: auto-odo LIVE hai — asli drive ke baad app kholte hue clip record kar lo (hook #11 ka raw material, launch reel stock)
Scripts + clips dono trial freelancers ko

days.label: Din 5
owner: Referral flow (give-1/get-1) design shuru (1–2h)
Teammate ko listing ke liye raw app screenshots do (auto-odo + refuel screens SABSE pehle — ye differentiator hai)
teammate: Listing screenshots Canva me: 8 outcome-frames, captions PLAY_LISTING.md se. Screenshot #1 = auto-odometer ('km khud ginta hai'). Aaj 4 bana lo
Roz ka 15-min reviews/DM block aaj se aadat me

days.label: Din 6 — owner ka dev block
owner: Referral build complete + full regression (:androidApp:assembleDebug + module tests + E2E) + v1.3.x RC (review prompt + referral). Auto-odo/refuel/paywall pe koi regression nahi — chhedna nahi
teammate: Baaki 4 screenshots + IG/YT bio final (halka din)

days.label: Din 7 — owner ka release/ASO ghanta
owner: RC internal → closed testing pe (1h). Dono devices pe install, dogfood: review-prompt trigger ek baar, referral code generate+redeem ek baar
doneWhen: v1.3.x closed testing pe, 2 devices pe chal raha

days.label: Din 8
days.weekGoal: HAFTA 2 (Din 8–14): v1.3.x PRODUCTION Din 9 ko, nayi listing live, pehli 2 Reels post, 20 groups join.
owner: Closed-track dogfood + crash check (1h). Blocker nahi → kal submit ki taiyari
teammate: Pehla Monday scoreboard (30 min, owner ke saath) — sab ~zero hai, theek hai, aadat ban rahi hai
Hafte ka content calendar: Reel #1 (Din 9), Reel #2 (Din 11)
10 sabse active groups join. Link NAHI, intro NAHI — pehle 3 hafte sirf value (GROWTH_PLAN.md §5 rule)

days.label: Din 9 — PRODUCTION
owner: v1.3.x PRODUCTION submit (staged rollout 20%) (1h). Review prompt + referral ab revenue-adjacent numbers ginna shuru (ratings, k-factor)
teammate: Reel #1 POST (IG + YT Shorts + dono ke WhatsApp status)
Dono trial reels ka QC (hook 1.5s? captions? template? CTA? data readable?). Winner = regular editor, doosra = backup

days.label: Din 10
owner: Nayi listing live: title/short/full PLAY_LISTING.md se + 8 naye screenshots (1h). Baseline note karo (aaj ke impressions/conversion)
teammate: Reel #3 (hook #9 resale PDF) ka packet regular editor ko — PDF-hero shot winner editor ka pehla regular kaam

days.label: Din 11
owner: Rollout crash-free/vitals check (30 min)
teammate: Reel #2 POST (4 jagah)
5 aur groups (total 20). Pehla genuine value-comment kisi group me

days.label: Din 12
owner: Rollout 20% → 50% (ya crash dikhe to halt + fix pehle) (1–2h)
Sab green → referral announce: push + dono ke status
teammate: Groups me observe: kaunse posts chalte hain, har group ke top-3 active members sheet me

days.label: Din 13 — owner ka dev block
owner: Rollout monitor (crash-free, vitals, pehla paid? pehla referral redeem?)
Seed-prep: seed-user list ke liye personal-message drafts (Hafta 3) + review-prompt/referral edge-case buffer (self-referral, code reuse) agar closed-track data me kuch dikha ho
teammate: Content sheet update, reel views note (halka)

days.label: Din 14 — owner ka release/ASO ghanta
owner: Rollout 50% → 100% (ya crash dikhe to halt + fix pehle) (1h)

days.label: Din 15
days.weekGoal: HAFTA 3 (Din 15–21): 20 genuine seed installs + honest reviews (review-prompt + referral ab pehli baar asli users pe), daily status, Reels #3–4 live.
owner: Rollout 100% (30 min). Crash dashboard roz ka 5-min ritual aaj se
teammate: Monday scoreboard (pehle asli numbers: installs, listing baseline, views)
Seed list: 20 genuine friends/family jo sach me gaadi rakhte hain — har naam ke aage kaun puchega, kab (sheet ka Seed tab)
Daily WhatsApp status shuru (dono ke number) — aaj se har din ek

days.label: Din 16
owner: Reviews/DM reply ritual (30 min). Halka din — koi naya build nahi
teammate: Reel #3 POST (4 jagah)
5 aur groups (total 25). Do genuine value-comments

days.label: Din 17
teammate: Reels #5–6 ke scripts + recordings editor ko
both: Seed push shuru: 10 logo ko personal message (har ek ko uski gaadi ke hisaab se ek line — blast NAHI). Install ke baad haath pakad ke: pehla service log + ek reminder set + auto-odo enroll (D7 ka sabse bada hook) + referral code share unke ek dost ke saath (asli test, pehli baar)

days.label: Din 18
teammate: Status + groups routine. Aayi reels ka QC
both: Baaki 10 seed installs. Jinhone 2 din chalayi unse honest review — 'jo sach me lagta hai wahi likho' (review-prompt khud happy-moment pe maangega; manually push mat karo). Fake KABHI nahi — Play pakadta hai, account termination

days.label: Din 19
owner: Pehla paid check (RevenueCat): koi ₹99 export / Pro? Pehla referral redemption bhi check (referral table). Seed me se 1–2 bhi = Target-track (1h)
teammate: Reel #4 POST (jo category R1–R3 me best chali, uska hook)
5 aur groups (total 30). r/CarsIndia + Team-BHP rules phir padho — agle hafte pehla post

days.label: Din 20 — owner ka dev block
owner: Seed feedback triage: 30-min wale fixes aaj hi (typo, copy, chhota bug), crash sabse pehle. Review-prompt/referral ka real-data bug dikhe (galat trigger, double-credit) to yahi fix karo
teammate: Content sheet + is hafte ki best reel note (halka)

days.label: Din 21 — owner ka release/ASO ghanta
owner: v1.3.x.1 submit (zaroorat ho to): seed-surfaced quick fixes (1h)
doneWhen: Patch submitted (ya 'koi fix zaroori nahi' likha)

days.label: Din 22
days.weekGoal: HAFTA 4 (Din 22–28): LAUNCH REEL (#11) + pehla group value-post, Reels #5–8 pipeline, pehla listing-conversion data point.
owner: Monday scoreboard (30 min) — ab har row me number
teammate: LAUNCH REEL packet — hook #11 pakka: 'Maine kuch nahi kiya. App ne khud kilometre gin liye.' Din 4 ka drive-clip + zaroorat ho to fresh clip aaj. Editor ko rush request (24h, thoda extra do)
Bache groups join (jo bache hain)

days.label: Din 23
owner: Review replies (24h rule) + crash check (30 min)
teammate: Pehla value-post sabse strong FB group me (3 hafte ki goodwill ke baad): 'Documented record = resale pe ₹20–40k zyada' — asli screenshot ke saath. Link NAHI. Din bhar comments me raho; koi app puchhe TABHI naam
Reels #7–8 ke scripts + recordings editor ko

days.label: Din 24 — LAUNCH REEL
owner: Referral k-factor ka pehla asli read (seed cohort ke data se) — is number pe hi M2 ka 'iterate ya chhodo' faisla (30 min)
teammate: LAUNCH REEL POST — 4 jagah + goodwill groups (jahan video allowed). Din bhar comments/DM pe

days.label: Din 25
owner: Installs ka source-split (Console → Store performance → Search terms): search vs social (30 min)
teammate: Launch reel ka doosra format test: wahi content, naya hook text/thumbnail — editor ko variant assign

days.label: Din 26
owner: Paid count vs gate (≥5): 3 se kam → seed users me jinke records bane hain unhe PDF export ka personal demo (dikhana, bechna nahi) (30 min)
teammate: Reel #5 POST
Doosre group me value-post #2 (PUC fine / winter-prep angle, group ke mizaaj se)
15-min DM/review block

days.label: Din 27 — owner ka dev block
owner: Listing conversion — pehla asli data point: >20% → sab theek, M2 me traffic focus; 15–20% → theek, A/B M3 me, kuch mat badlo; <15% → RED: screenshot #1 redo hi agla dev-block ka kaam (GROWTH_PLAN.md rule)
Saath me: review-prompt ka data (kitne prompts dikhe, kitne reviews) + referral k-factor ka doosra data point
teammate: Reel #6 QC (halka)

days.label: Din 28 — owner ka release/ASO ghanta
owner: Gate pre-check (1h) — 2 din pehle gap dikh jaye to bharne ka time hai: installs? conversion? paid? crash-free? D7 (pehla seed cohort)?
teammate: Reel #6 POST (4 jagah)

days.label: Din 29 — Month close
days.weekGoal: Din 29–30: month close. Gate (Din 30): 250 installs · conversion >20% · ≥5 paid · crash-free >99% · D7 >15%.
teammate: Reel #7 POST + Reel #8 QC
both: Extended scoreboard (1h): poora table Floor/Target ke against + '3 wins' ritual (kharab mahina ho to bhi 3 milengi) + content audit: 8 reels me best hook kaunsa? Wahi category M2 me double

days.label: Din 30 — GATE REVIEW
teammate: M2 W1 ka content calendar draft (winter-prep hooks #21, #22)
both: GATE REVIEW (1h saath, imaandaari se): Installs 250 / conversion >20% / paid ≥5 / crash-free >99% / D7 >15%. Sab pass → M2 sirf iteration + winter-prep content, koi naya build nahi (pehle paid user ka screenshot frame karo). Conversion fail → M2 W1 dev slot screenshot #1 redo ko. Installs fail + conversion pass → reach problem: content volume + winter-prep wave, plan mat badlo. Kaam hi nahi hua → plan ka dosh nahi; pehle discipline, phir plan judge
doneWhen: Gate table bhari + agla mahina unlocked/adjusted, likh ke
